snippet.title: Trials Rising: Sixty Six Expansion Pack Trailer
snippet.description:
Trials Rising Sixty-Six Expansion is Now Available!

Enjoy the scenery of the Grand Canyon or courageously ride through the Ghost Town to get your kicks and flips on Route 66.

Trials Rising Sixty-Six Expansion contains 24 new tracks with 2 stadium finals and 2 skill games, 1 outfit, new contracts and new hidden squirrel collectables.
